description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named NotificationRequest used for creating notifications. It includes fields for user ID, notification type, and message, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. The class is annotated for Swagger documentation and Jakarta validation.

classes.name: NotificationRequest
classes.description: DTO class for creating notification requests, encapsulating user ID, type, and message.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the target user ID for the notification.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the notification type (e.g., INFO, ALERT, WARNING).

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the target user ID for the notification.
